title: Land Grants (Special Provisions) Act
long_title: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE VESTING IN THE STATE, OF AGRICULTURAL OR ESTATE LAND WHICH IS VESTED IN THE LAND REFORM COMMISSION UNDER THE LAND REFORM LAW; TO ENABLE THE TRANSFER, FREE OF CHARGE, TO THE LANDLESS, OF THE LANDS SO VESTED IN THE STATE; AND TO PROVIDE FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.

body.heading: Nomination of successor to State land transferred under section 3.

children.raw_text: (1) A person to whom any State land is transferred under section 3 or any person on whom the rights of the first-mentioned person in such land have devolved (in this subsection referred to as " the grantee") may nominate a successor who shall be entitled to succeed to the rights of the grantee in such land upon the death of the grantee. A nomination made in pursuance of this subsection shall be deemed not to be a disposition within the meaning of section 5(1) (a).

body.heading: Conditions to which a transfer under section 3 is deemed to be subject, to run with the land.
body.raw_text: 11. The burden of any condition to which any transfer of State land under section 3 is deemed to be subject, shall run with the land and shall be binding upon the transferee and upon all persons claiming that land through, from, or under, such transferee.

body.heading: Disposition of land transferred under section 3 without the consent in writing, of the Land Commissioner void and inoperative.
body.raw_text: 12. Where any person to whom any State land is transferred under section 3 effects a disposition of that land without the prior consent in writing of the Land Commissioner given in accordance with the provisions of section 5 (1) (a) such disposition shall be void and inoperative for all purposes.

body.heading: Rectification of errors, & c, in instrument of depositions.
body.raw_text: 13. Where it appears to the Government Agent of the administrative district within which any State land transferred under disposition. section 3 is situated that any instrument of disposition effecting such transfer contains any clerical or other error or requires amendment in respect of the description of the land comprised therein or in respect of the inscription or recital of the name or designation of the transferee or of any other material fact, such error may be rectified or such amendment may be made by an endorsement on such instrument of disposition signed by such Government Agent and the transferee; and any endorsement so signed shall be sufficient for all purposes to rectify the error or to effect the amendment; and the instrument on which any such endorsement is made shall have effect as though it had been originally issued or executed as so rectified or amended.

body.heading: Alluvial and other accretions to any land transferred under section 3.
body.raw_text: 14. Any alluvial or other accretion to any State land transferred under section 3 shall, together with all rights appertaining or belonging to such accretion, be the property of the State and is hereby declared to be vested in the State.

body.heading: Power to inspect any State land transferred under section 3.
body.raw_text: 15. The Government Agent of the administrative district within which any State land transferred under section 3 is situated, or any officer authorized in writing by such Government Agent, may at any time enter and inspect such land, for the purposes of ascertaining whether any condition to which such transfer is deemed to be subject is being complied with.

body.heading: Administration of this Act.

body.heading: Reference to Land Commissioner in case of doubt.

children.raw_text: (1) Any public officer entrusted with any duties in respect of, or connected with, the implementation of this Act shall, on his own or at the instance of the Land Commissioner, refer to such Land Commissioner for decision, any question of doubt or difficulty in connexion with the performance of such duties.
